content.text: Summary: Inspected the edge namespace and found both api-gateway pods mount gateway-limits via a `subPath`, which per the Kubernetes docs blocks ConfigMap live updates. The pods started well before the 09:10 edit, so they're still using the old 100 rps limit. Resolved the ticket with instructions to `kubectl rollout restart` the deployment now, and to drop the `subPath` so future limit changes propagate without a restart.
